pairs.q: mother of Pentheus; daughter of Cadmus; sister of Autonoe, Ino, and Semele; leader of the Theban Bacchae; not on stage until 1168
frenzied female worshippers of Dionysus; also called 'maenads'
aged former king of Thebes; father of Agave, Autonoe, and Semele; he has abdicated in favor of his grandson
Fifteen Bacchae from Lydia; also called 'maenads' (mad-women); who provide commentary and plot information on the play
son of the immortal Zeus and the mortal Semele; first cousin of Pentheus; appears both as a god and as a human, ie. as the disguised Lydian 'Stranger'
one of Pentheus' guards who describes how the Stranger was captured near Cithaeron and how the jailed Bacchae miraculously escaped to the mountain
a herdsman from Thebes who describes the oracles of the Theban Bacchae on Mt. Cithaeron
son of Agave and Echion; first cousin of Dionysus; successor to his grandfather Cadmus as king of Thebes; probably 18-20 years old
the blind old prophet of Thebes and friend of Cadmus
